notes: Annual report of the Board of Park Commissioners for the year ending June 30, 1893. Curated: Stow Lake's completion.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: Huntington Falls on Strawberry Hill (no page), the new pumping works in a Moorish concrete building 40 by 100 feet with Union Iron Works machinery, the second story of Sweeney's Observatory.

findings.description: The lake around Strawberry Hill was finished as a reservoir, holding twenty to twenty-five million gallons high enough to irrigate five-sixths of the park by gravity; the hill, now an island, was reached from the northeast over the concrete Roman bridge and from the southwest by a stone footbridge added because so many people walked out to the lake, and carriages could drive about three-quarters of the way around it.

citation.label: Annual report of the Board of Park Commissioners of San Francisco for the year ending June 30, 1893, The lake
